review_description: Raa initially had a problem with getting the batteries and have gone above and beyond to make sure that I now receive installation of a differnt brand of batteries and quick installation

Quote process was excellent and fair. Well explained and a great quotationInstallation was very good , explained and and gave options, fixed old tiles while on site , very tidy, very punctualArrange connection seamlessly and assisted with apps connected and supported explanations

Service was great. Called raa they advised what system we needed as we have shading issues in winterI got a report showing what the system would produce every quarterThey also advised to fill the roof with panels as you recommend as wellWe got a 10.5 kw systemWith solar edge inverter, power optimiser Trina tsm 440neg9r panels with solar edge monitoring

Too many fly by nighters in the solar industry pushing for a fast sale.  Too many interstate based companies relying on sub contractors who might not be in the business when the inevitable warranty repair crops up.  RAA are SA based, send out local trades employed by RAA and without any of the hard sell.  Guys rocked up yesterday at 7am and finished today before lunch.  Not the cheapest quote but well within the ball park.
Totally satisfied from start to finish of the entire process.
